Name: KyuubiSoftAPI
Description: REST API for KyuubiSoft Panel - player data (real health/gamemode), server stats (real TPS), player actions (heal/kill/teleport/gamemode/clear-inventory via in-process commands), real-time events (incl. periodic player_position with real ping), and Prometheus metrics. Built against the Hytale 2026-05 server API.
Author: KyuubiDDragon
